comment: Per-file typecheck counts for the test tree, and the ratchet in `scripts/typecheck-per-file.js` refuses a file
**Recorded 2026-10-10, from a run of `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` that produced 35 errors in 5 files.** The
baseline was empty before this, so every one of them read as *new* - **and the reason they surfaced today is
that the lint gate began reading the package test directories**, which put the same files in front of a typed
tool for the first time. **A baseline records what is there so that a change to it is visible**; it is not a
claim that the errors are acceptable, and **the count is the number a fix has to bring down.**
**Empty since iteration 98, and both entries it held were real defects rather than noise.**
`real-ground-truth-gate.test.ts` read `.region` on a shape that did not declare it, five times, while the field
was in the committed dataset all along - the interface described the dataset as the test *wished* it were. It is
now `IssueFile` + `GroundTruthEntry`, carrying every field the dataset has, so a field that moves there surfaces
as an error instead of as an `undefined`. `app-with-taint/src/config.ts` read `process.env.SEARCH_PREFIX`, which
the index signature of `process.env` forbids. **A baseline that records a real defect is a defect with a
receipt**: both were fixed rather than re-recorded, and the ratchet now holds the empty object.
